# Rejected submission regression fixtures

These are the user-supplied scenario A, B and C exports and their corresponding
closure violation reports from 2026-09-19. The ZIP fixtures contain the original
three CSV files unchanged; macOS download metadata has been omitted.

The reports contain 47, 84 and 47 messages respectively. The validator must
reproduce these exact messages, regardless of ordering. These fixtures provide
observed checker behavior, not a copy of the external checker or its complete
specification. New solves must pass the corrected internal validator.
